summary: Per-call countdown timer that, while its gate byte (this+0x24) is clear, decrements the float timer at this+0x3C by the per-tick delta returned from ScoringGateConditionCheck. When the timer reaches zero or below it decodes the current session phase, picks a random target state from {0, 3, 4, 5} with an LCG modulo, requests the chosen state transition through GameActionStateMachine (twice when it differs from the decoded phase), and with one-third probability additionally targets the race leader camera via CameraTargetRaceLeader. On firing it runs ShortComputation_d360 over the dwords at this+0x30 and this+0x34 and returns a non-zero fired flag; otherwise it returns zero. Called from MainCameraDirectorUpdate (0040CA30).

local_names.this: timer/state machine object owned by the camera director
local_names.v2: return flag: 1 when the timer fired this call, 0 otherwise
local_names.v3: updated countdown value written back to this+0x3C
local_names.v4: current session phase decoded by SessionPhaseDecode

operations.description: Initializes the return flag v2 to 0 before the gate check
Gate: when the byte at this+0x24 is non-zero the entire timer body is skipped and the function returns 0
Reads the per-tick delta by calling ScoringGateConditionCheck on this
Countdown update: subtracts the ScoringGateConditionCheck result from the float at this+0x3C and writes the new value back to this+0x3C
Timer expiry: when the updated countdown value is zero or below the random state transition fires
Decodes the current session phase into v4 via SessionPhaseDecode(this)
Random target selection: takes RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator() modulo 4 and maps the result to a target state (0 -> 0, 1 -> 3, 2 -> 4, otherwise 5), compiled to the jump table jpt_40C0BD
Requests the randomly selected state v5 with argument 1 through GameActionStateMachine
When the selected state v5 differs from the decoded phase v4, GameActionStateMachine is called a second time with the same arguments
Re-issues the state transition GameActionStateMachine(v5, 1) when the selected state differs from the current phase
Race-leader chance: fires only when RandLCGRandomNumberGenerator() modulo 3 is zero (one-in-three probability)
Targets the race leader camera via CameraTargetRaceLeader(1) on the one-in-three roll
Sets the fired flag v2 to 1 once the random transition has been issued
Runs ShortComputation_d360 with the dword at this+0x30 as first argument and the dword at this+0x34 as second argument
Returns the fired flag v2 (1 when the timer fired this call, 0 otherwise)
